scope: exploratory provenance-stratified residual audit of historical terminal translations; not production adjudication and not a causal reviewer-effect experiment

services: Anthropic first-party via Claude Code CLI
Z.ai CN via Pi custom provider
authorization.basis: The user explicitly requested the listed GLM, Opus and Fable routes, then asked to continue the systematic-bias research after completing the Paseo snapshot.
authorization.data_scope: 20 source/target/fixed-context records deterministically sampled from the already authorized ToME4 translation-review corpus; no credentials, control-plane metadata, old findings, old verdicts or model-family provenance are sent

sampling.unit: five tasks per provenance stratum, then one terminal revision per task
sampling.qualification: task/topic/workflow composition differs across strata, so between-stratum differences are descriptive and cannot identify a causal reviewer or orchestrator effect

output_schema.enforcement: CLI schema where supported plus independent exact-order local validation

routes.tools: disabled by read-only /tmp execution and the prompt contract

routes.advisor: disabled by safe-mode and project,local-only setting sources
routes.runtime_identity_rule: the full task must initialize and emit assistant messages as claude-opus-5 with no fallback

routes.advisor: disabled by safe-mode and project,local-only setting sources
routes.runtime_identity_rule: the full task must initialize and emit assistant messages as claude-fable-5 with no fallback

routes.interpretation: composite route reported separately from pure Opus and Fable

preregistered_analysis.candidate_generation: retain every FINDING and UNCERTAIN from each independent route; atomize overlaps only after all outputs exist
preregistered_analysis.adjudication_rule: mechanics and semantic claims require fixed source, placeholder binding, runtime path or another reproducible record; style-only claims cannot be confirmed defects
preregistered_analysis.blinding: review routes do not receive provenance; provenance strata are joined only after candidate outputs are frozen
reports: descriptive confirmed residual-defect count by provenance stratum
advisor composite versus pure-route candidate-set changes
preregistered_analysis.prohibited_inference: do not infer GPT reviewer bias, reviewer causality, natural corpus defect prevalence or human-language quality from this 20-item pilot alone

ground_truth_limit: There is no independent human reviewer and no pre-existing sealed reference. The current GPT/Codex research agent may assemble source evidence after inference, so the result must be described as source-constrained adjudication rather than independent ground truth.
